clue.text: Agree to maintain connection

explanation.surface: Someone consents to keep in touch.
explanation.definitionFit: To correspond is both to tally or match up and to exchange letters with someone over time.

clue.text: Finished in a superior position

explanation.definitionFit: Something done with is ended, and a thing placed above another sits higher up.

clue.text: Appalling rotter — still!

indicators.note: appalling suggests something dreadful, a mess, so the letters of the next word are scrambled

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a dreadful scoundrel is still there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'still!' looks like an adverb of surprise, but it is the noun: a distilling apparatus. 'Appalling' rearranges ROTTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A retort is a glass vessel with a long bent neck used in distillation, a kind of laboratory still.

clue.text: A person letting fly about pound fine

indicators.note: about here means going round, so one piece is wrapped around the other

parts.note: someone who lets something fly is sending it off, a sender
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone throwing things around over a one-pound fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fine' reads as a penalty, but it means thin or delicate.
explanation.definitionFit: Fine as in thin and delicate, like a slight thread, is a synonym.

clue.text: None should go to prison if honest

parts.note: none is zero, which looks like the letter O
a pen is an enclosure, slang for a prison (as in penitentiary)

explanation.surface: Nobody should be jailed if they tell the truth.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone frank and candid with nothing hidden is a synonym for truthful.

clue.text: Rescind reforms, see?

indicators.note: reforms means the letters are formed again into a new order

explanation.surface: A demand to cancel reforms, with a 'see?' tagged on.
explanation.definitionFit: To see in the sense of perceive or make out is a synonym.

clue.text: Get together — not for the first time

definitions.text: Get together — not for the first time

parts.words: Get together — not for the first time
parts.note: to get together again is to gather once more, a second meeting rather than the first

explanation.definitionFit: To come together again after having previously met or been assembled is a synonym of regroup.

clue.text: One appropriately treated is striking and calm

parts.note: workers on strike are out
patient means calm and tolerant

explanation.surface: A person who is on strike yet calm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'striking' suggests impressive, but it means on strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone attending hospital for treatment without staying overnight; the clue's 'appropriately treated' plays on being treated out.

clue.text: Smart man in politics, maybe a Unionist

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of words that follows, maybe a Unionist

parts.note: the letters run from the end of maybe across a into the start of Unionist

explanation.surface: A stylish politician who might be a Unionist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'politics' is surface colour; the answer lies inside 'maybE A Unionist'.
explanation.definitionFit: A beau is a dandy, a fashionable well-dressed fellow.

clue.text: With grub the head shows moderation

parts.note: a gentle is a maggot, the grub used as fishing bait
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness's neighbours on the coast

explanation.surface: Someone eating shows restraint.
explanation.walkthrough: GENTLE is an old word for a maggot used by anglers; NESS is a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: Mildness and restraint of manner are synonyms here.

clue.text: Act badly, taking to drink-the sauce!

indicators.note: badly done means the letters of the word are messed about

parts.note: to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: Someone behaves badly after taking to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Catsup is an old and American spelling of ketchup, the tomato condiment.

clue.text: Keeps the French players in the lead

indicators.note: in the lead says one piece comes first, ahead of the other

parts.note: the cast are the actors in a play
les is French for the (plural)

explanation.surface: French sportsmen hold forts while leading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keeps' looks like a verb, but it is the plural noun: a keep is a castle's strongest tower.
explanation.definitionFit: A keep is the central fortified tower, so fortresses are an example.

clue.text: Police records under "Swindles"

indicators.note: in a down clue, under places one piece below the other

parts.note: cons are swindles or tricks
tables are lists of records and figures

explanation.surface: Police files filed under the heading of fraud.
explanation.definitionFit: Constables are officers of the police force, an example of its members.

clue.text: Chose to give voice-escorted from the scene!

parts.note: to sing is to give voice in song
led means escorted or guided
out means away from the place

explanation.surface: A singer is picked, then ushered off stage.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick someone in particular for attention is to select them.

clue.text: The man's Spanish or possibly Norse

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters could be ordered another way

explanation.surface: Debating whether a man is Spanish or Scandinavian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges NORSE. The 'or' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Señor is the Spanish title for a gentleman, equivalent to Mr.

clue.text: The plan is to extend

explanation.surface: Stating that the scheme is to expand.
explanation.definitionFit: A project is a planned undertaking, and to project is to jut out or stick forward.

clue.text: The great fear of all in charge

parts.note: pan- is a Greek prefix meaning all, as in pandemic

explanation.surface: The terror felt by the boss of everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Sudden overwhelming fright or alarm is a synonym.

clue.text: Shakespearean princess going about on horseback

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: back taken from horseback says the horse word is read in reverse

parts.note: a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: A royal heroine riding about on horseback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horseback' splits into 'horse' and 'back'; 'going' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Regan is one of King Lear's two cruel daughters in Shakespeare's tragedy.

clue.text: Number One in the North and North-east

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: N is the abbreviation for north
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: The top number in northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine is a figure, an example of a number.

clue.text: Bale made up by expert

indicators.note: made up suggests the letters are put together afresh

explanation.surface: A hay bale assembled by a skilled hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Able means skilful and competent, a synonym.

clue.text: Joking but firm with pests failing to finish

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm

indicators.note: failing to finish says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: mice are household pests

explanation.surface: A firm joking about its pest control problems.
explanation.definitionFit: Comic means funny, intended to make people laugh.

clue.text: Such trickery may come a cropper

parts.note: can and may both express being permitted or able
to come a cropper is British slang for to fall, as in trip up

explanation.surface: A trick that might end in a nasty fall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come a cropper' is British slang for having a fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantrip is a Scots word for a witch's spell or a mischievous trick.

clue.text: Taking care of charges they're timid

parts.note: c/o, written CO, is the postal abbreviation for care of
wards are those in someone's charge

explanation.surface: Timid people looking after those in their charge.
explanation.definitionFit: People lacking courage, faint-hearted ones, are cowards.

clue.text: Stop on the way — pay for it!

definitions.text: Stop on the way — pay for it!

parts.words: Stop on the way — pay for it!
parts.note: a barrier across a road where travellers halt and must hand over a fee to pass

explanation.definitionFit: A tollbar is a gate across a road where a charge is paid before passing.

clue.text: Combined effort puts many onto a sure thing

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
on means onto or atop
a cert is British slang for a certainty

explanation.surface: A team effort that bets heavily on a sure winner.
explanation.walkthrough: CERT is British slang for a certainty, especially a racing tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in concert means acting together, so joint action is a sense.

clue.text: Against carrying a woman's gun

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
Ann is a woman's name

explanation.surface: Opposed to a woman bearing a firearm.
explanation.definitionFit: A cannon is a large heavy piece of artillery.

clue.text: Call back to obtain a financial plan

indicators.note: back here says the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to dub is to call or name
get means obtain

explanation.surface: Ringing back to secure an agreed spending scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Call' as a verb gives DUB, as in knighting someone by naming them; 'back' is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A budget is an estimate of income and spending for a period.

clue.text: To drop a point tappears prudent

parts.note: to sag is to droop or drop
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Losing a point seems wise.
explanation.definitionFit: Sage means wise and judicious.

clue.text: Holiday price around the end of August

indicators.note: around means one piece goes round the other

parts.note: a fee is a price charged

indicators.note: the end of picks the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Holiday costs at the end of summer.
explanation.definitionFit: A fête is a festival or celebration, a festive day.

clue.text: A jogger gets the bird in America

explanation.surface: A runner sees an American bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who runs on streets is a road runner; the American cuckoo of the deserts is the roadrunner.

clue.text: Sewing case used in some suitable tuition

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A needlework case used in good teaching.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'used', but 'used in' is the link joining definition to the hidden run; a sewing case is the whole sense.
explanation.definitionFit: An étui is a small ornamental case for needles and similar items.

clue.text: Nicer requests aren't acted upon

parts.note: pleas are requests or appeals

indicators.note: acted upon means worked on, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Polite requests are being ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: More agreeable, kinder, is a comparative synonym.
